visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged Asian man wearing a tan high-collar jacket stands in a brightly lit, crowded exhibition hall, holding a copy of the book '21 Lessons for the 21st Century'. He speaks directly into a handheld camera with an animated expression. The background is filled with bookshelves and numerous passers-by at the Taipei International Book Exhibition. (2) The camera zooms in on the book's pages as the man's hands point to specific passages discussing AI and music. Digital text overlays in Traditional Chinese flash on the screen to emphasize his points. (3) The scene shifts to include stylized digital graphics of neural networks and data streams, symbolizing artificial intelligence. (4) A short sequence depicts a female doctor in a white coat consulting a male patient in a clinical setting, followed by digital 'AI Medical Imaging' overlays representing healthcare technology. (5) The man returns to the center frame in the bookstore, holding the book high and gesturing with his free hand to underscore his final thoughts on the speed of technological realization. (6) The video concludes with the man looking into the camera, holding two books side-by-side, still in the crowded exhibition venue.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Retrospective Evidence -> Future Projection -> Summary Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to validate the host's long-term foresight regarding Artificial Intelligence by referencing a book he recommended years ago. By showing how the book's 2018 predictions are now reality (AI in music, art, and medicine), he establishes credibility and encourages viewers to stay intellectually proactive.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host holds the book throughout the video, explicitly discusses its contents, and uses it as a primary source for his educational message.
